name: api
description: Typed API contract service (W059): the route table AS DATA — every public/private route (path pattern, closed method set, closed request/response field schemas, the explicit tenant/project/world scope each route requires as path parameters — §14, versioned immutable lineages) with fail-closed construction + whole-record re-validation (unique content-addressed route ids, unique method+path, W028 provenance citations on every data-carrying response — or the honest no-declared-source marker — and R016: every time-machine route carries an explicit required cutoff, an implicit-latest route is a loud typed violation). A14: CONTRACTS ONLY — no HTTP serving (W062), no authn/authz execution (W060), no observability (W061), no I/O.
